VERDICT: CLEAN

BOUNDARY: Empty \(K\) handled: the null cover can be empty, yielding an empty finite cover. Degenerate (side‑length \(0\)) cubes enlarge to nondegenerate cubes whose interiors contain the original point; the open‑cover argument still holds. The construction uses no choice principle: each enlargement can be given explicitly by centring and side‑length increase.

SOURCES: All nine supplied dependencies were inspected. `def-null-and-content-zero-in-rn` provides the definitions and the forward implication (L1). `def-metric-compactness`, `lem-compactness-is-intrinsic` and `def-metric-topology` together justify L2 (a compact subset admits finite subcovers from ambient open covers). `thm-geometric-series` justifies the sum of the added volumes. The remaining items (`def-finite-sum`, `lem-finite-sum-laws`, `def-multidimensional-rectangle-and-volume`, `thm-heine-borel-rn`) are consistent with the argument or supply required background.

CHECKED: Title and public statement verified. Proof steps 1.1–4.1 checked: the forward direction is exactly L1; the reverse direction correctly uses the null hypothesis to obtain a countable cover, enlarges the cubes to produce an open cover, applies compactness to select a finite subcover, and bounds the total volume by the original series plus a geometric series. Remarks are consistent with the reasoning.
